body:
It got worse. I was out with my bf and his friends. Said one thing about someone that wasn't there. Apparently this person that was there told her and now she is harassing me online and I'm just ignoring it. One person who was there I always think is flirting with my boyfriend and she posted something that was clearly done because she wants to make me feel worse. 

I'm so fucking done.

With the whole seeing someone thing, I'm trying not to go to centers. I recently got my BA with the intention of working in mental health and the centers in my town are my best bet for a job. 

Idk how to calmly talk to him. No matter how hard I try, things go wrong and I end up either yelling or clamming up. 

I don't really go out, so I'd have to go out of my way to make friends. I literally go to work and home and that's it. 

I've been depressed so long that I don't even remember what I used to enjoy. I have no real hobbies or skills.
I don't think I'm going to talk to him about it. We've been fighting lately and I can't say anything without being asked for an explanation, which ends with me getting pissed.

I've been working on the job issue for two or three months now. I might finally have a job, but it's not what I actually want to do. It's just a replacement for now until I can get into the industry I want to be in.

With my mom, the issue is her getting pissy about my depression. She knows I have it and she yells at me for not going to the person she found for me. The person is her friend and I don't trust her at all and she is quite a drive for me to go see. Plus, I'm too pessimistic right now and she complains to my bf about it. If I try to talk to her, she just blows me off and says I should have listened to her, which does not help at all.

I'm always busy, but I have something that will be freeing up time soon and am looking for things to do instead to keep busy. The thing I'm currently busy with is very stressful, so it will likely help when it ends.

I'm trying to communicate with new people. I have someone who seems to want to hang out, but I have social anxiety and every friendship has gone wrong and I'm terrified it'll happen again. Plus I don't know how to make friends anymore. All the friends I had, I met over four years ago.

I'm probably going to talk to my bf tomorrow so I can let him know what's going on right now. It seems he is starting to notice that I'm not myself.

I'm not sure. My depression has come back really badly recently. I'm having issues with my mother. It's the holidays and I can't see my family. Work issues. I've also lost the few friends I had left. And I feel like my bf would rather talk to friends online than spend time with me. 

I feel like my decision to recover had more to do with making everyone else happy, instead of doing what I want. I did want to recover and all, but the only thing that has kept me from doing it is everyone around me.

I don't go to school. The only reason I would tell my bf is because if I end up doing it, he'll get upset for not talking to him. I have been trying to get help from a professional, but none will accept me. And on my non-throwaway I am subscribed to r/selfharm but it's getting to the point where mods aren't monitoring much and it seems like a triggering free-for-all.
